title: Saint Louis University grad tops September 2026 social workers licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Saint Louis University achieved the highest score in the licensure examination for social workers held earlier this month.

blocks.text: A graduate of Saint Louis University achieved the highest score in the licensure examination for social workers held earlier this month.
According to the The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 8,383 test takers out of 10,991 passed the exam, given by the Board for Social Workers in 18 testing centers across the Philippines.
Zirc Iram Dela Cruz Sanchez of Saint Louis University was the top scorer with 93.40%, while several schools achieved a 100% passing rate.
